headline: Australia Approves Oral Wegovy Pill in Global First for Novo Nordisk
summary: Australian regulators approved a new tablet version of Novo Nordisk's weight-loss drug Wegovy, marking the oral treatment's first approval globally.
why: Novo Nordisk is Europe's largest company by market capitalization, with its GLP-1 treatments driving significant revenue growth.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: First regulatory approval for an oral formulation of Wegovy expands market access and patient adoption potential.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Regulatory approval of the oral formulation opens a new market segment for Novo Nordisk's flagship obesity drug.
